research.text:
What award-winning health sites do

• Health By Habit (Awwwards Site of the Day, Synchronized Studio): one bold accent on black and white, big imagery, motion (GSAP).
• Function Health: a serif display face and simple animated charts that make complex lab data easy to follow.
• Headspace 2024 rebrand: custom typeface, a supporting palette chosen for contrast and accessibility.
• Bevel Health (Awwwards Honorable Mention, May 2026, NOOON): health-coach app site.
• Dribbble lab-result shots: a plain summary screen first, details second, one calm medical accent.

takeaways.text:
What that means for Day One

• Show the real product: paper in, plain plan out.
• One accent, lots of white space, big type.
• Body font: Atkinson Hyperlegible (made by the Braille Institute for low vision).
• Write the page at a grade-6 level, the AMA target for patient materials.
• The agent conversation is our hackathon story: put it on the page.
• Trust before features: sources, safety check, synthetic data.

brand.text:
Brand: Day Zero → Day One

• Day Zero = the team. Day One = the product.
• Pitch line: "Day Zero builds Day One, the app for a patient's first day back home."
• Team colours: #121212 black, #F3F1EA cream, #FF4A1C orange dot.
• Day One keeps the ring + orange dot as its mark; the product pages use the Calm & Critical palette: white and slate, navy text, blue for medicines and new instructions, crimson only for red flags, green for done.
